## Claude · Midas A7 model test
Compares gemini-nano-banana-2.1 and gemini-3-pro-image on the Drive > Testing photos with the stage 04 white-master prompt. Inventory from the owner's answer sheet; photo reading from the reader test table.
As shipped it is a PREVIEW: nothing is sent and nothing is paid. A paid run needs the owner's go in a message, paid_calls_allowed true and a new go_token in MT1 Config. Preview of 15 Oct: 10 calls, about USD 1.16 reserved (estimate from registry prices; one call can cost more than its estimate). The cap is USD 3 of estimates and 12 calls per go token.
Each call runs in "Claude · Midas A7 model test · one call". Results and the owner's verdict columns: data table "Claude Midas A7 model test". A made image is a candidate, not an approval.
